Title screens and screenshots as a fallback
When no source has box art for a game, use its title screen or an in-game screenshot (libretro-thumbnails and ScreenScraper). Off: only real covers.
Where to get the credentials

ScreenScraper only answers apps with developer credentials. Make a free account on screenscraper.fr, then ask for a developer id (id and password) on their forum, and fill both in here; the software name is the one you register with it. Your own screenscraper.fr login is optional and gives more requests per day and more speed. Until the developer id and password are filled in, ScreenScraper is skipped.

libretro-thumbnails
The box art RetroArch shows, found by the ROM\'s name. No account needed; other regions of the same game are tried too.
ScreenScraper
A large database of box art, searched by file name and then by title, in your preferred region. Needs developer credentials (below).
